_comment: The project.json settings a Python build needs (2.6.21). `python tools/preset.py python` writes each key below into .metaframework/project.json where the build has not set it; keys that start with _ are notes and are never written.
_notes: Standard library only (unittest), as LedgerCore V2 and PipelineGate build. Tests import the library from the repo root (from src.ledger import Ledger). Isolation tests are tests/**/test_<stem>_isolation.py: unittest's pattern finds them, so the full suite runs them, and tools/isolation-run.py runs them again with the environment cleared (Windows has no env -i). rederive_invoke stays the build's own: the command that drives one module through one vector.
